sections.title: Hero
sections.description: The layered mountain artwork and its scroll animation are part of the site design and stay in code.

fields.label: Headline
fields.help: Each line break starts a new line on the site.

fields.label: Subheading
fields.default: Enabling communities to adapt, lead and act in a changing climate.

fields.label: Intro
fields.default: Glaciers are vanishing fast, threatening water, ecosystems, and life.

default.label: 3x Faster Warming
default.description: The Cryosphere is warming three times faster than the global average, signaling an urgent climate crisis.

default.label: 50% Melt by 2100
default.description: Half of the world's glaciers could disappear by 2100, threatening ecosystems, water supplies, and sea levels.

default.label: Himalayan Ice Loss
default.description: Himalayan glaciers have lost over 40% of their ice volume since 2000, destabilizing regional water systems.

default.label: 2 Billion Lives at Risk
default.description: Over 2 billion people rely on glacier-fed rivers like the Ganges, Indus, Brahmaputra, and Yangtze for water and food.

default.label: Disrupted Livelihoods
default.description: Glacier retreat disrupts agriculture, hydropower generation, and water security, especially in vulnerable regions.

default.label: Glacial Flood Threat
default.description: Glacial lake outburst floods (GLOFs) are increasing in frequency, putting lives, infrastructure, and economies at risk.

default.label: Albedo Loss
default.description: Melting glaciers reduce Earth's reflectivity (albedo), causing the planet to absorb more heat and warm even faster.

default.label: Ecological & Cultural Loss
default.description: Fragile mountain ecosystems are collapsing, and Indigenous cultures rooted in the cryosphere are eroding rapidly.

fields.label: Text
fields.default: Without glaciers, we lose water, wisdom, and wonder. Yet they remain invisible in policy, education, and public imagination.

fields.label: Quote
fields.default: Glaciers store the world's freshwater, cool the planet, and sustain life. Their rapid disappearance is not just a climate crisis — it's a life crisis. The Voice of Glaciers Foundation exists to protect what remains, before silence replaces ice.

fields.label: Intro
fields.default: A dual-force ecosystem blending culture, science, and policy to protect glaciers and reimagine humanity’s bond with the cryosphere.

default.title: Foundation
default.subtitle: Voice of Glaciers Foundation
default.content:
Born inside a Himalayan glacier, TVGF is a gratitude movement rooted in lived survival.
We unite science, storytelling, spirituality, and stewardship to protect glaciers as sacred lifelines.
Where glaciers speak, communities rise, and the world listens.

default.title: Innovation Lab
default.subtitle: GlacierX & Creative Systems
default.content:
A living lab blending art, science, youth leadership, and policy.
From GlacierX gatherings and residencies to citizen science dashboards,
we design immersive experiences that turn awareness into action.

default.title: Catalytic Fund
default.subtitle: Sustaining Cryosphere Justice
default.content:
We mobilize philanthropic capital, CSR, and global partnerships
to accelerate glacier protection, education, monitoring,
and policy recognition across regions.

fields.label: Text
fields.default: Join researchers, storytellers, communities, and leaders working to protect glaciers and the people who depend on them.
